extra_vocab.en: a sport in which two teams throw a ball into a high net
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於公司活動、運動場館或員工福利的情境，指籃球運動或球本身。談到運動時通常不加冠詞。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 運動名稱前面不加 the 或 a：說 play basketball，不說 play the basketball。

example.en: The store sold fifty basketballs during the school sports week.
example.zh: 這家店在學校運動週期間賣出五十顆籃球。

example.en: Our staff play basketball in the gym every Friday evening.
example.zh: 我們的員工每週五晚上在體育館打籃球。

example.en: The company built a new basketball court behind the office.
example.zh: 公司在辦公室後面蓋了一座新籃球場。

example.en: We bought tickets for the basketball game next Saturday.
example.zh: 我們買了下週六籃球比賽的票。

examples.en: Our team joined a basketball tournament held by the city.
examples.zh: 我們的團隊參加了市政府舉辦的籃球錦標賽。

examples.en: The sports center has two indoor basketball courts for members.
examples.zh: 這個運動中心有兩座室內籃球場供會員使用。

examples.en: Please order ten new basketballs for the youth program.
examples.zh: 請為青少年活動訂購十顆新籃球。

confusable.diff: baseball 是棒球，basketball 是籃球，兩個字前半拼法很像。

example.en: We play basketball in the gym but baseball outside.
example.zh: 我們在體育館打籃球，在室外打棒球。

example.en: The company sponsors a baseball team in the local league.
example.zh: 這家公司贊助當地聯賽的一支棒球隊。

example.en: Many staff watch football games at the sports bar.
example.zh: 許多員工在運動酒吧看足球比賽。

example.en: We play volleyball at the beach during the summer trip.
example.zh: 我們在夏季旅遊時於海灘打排球。

example.en: He plays tennis with clients on weekend mornings.
example.zh: 他週末早上會和客戶打網球。

extra_vocab.en: something you buy for less than its normal price
extra_vocab.note: 多益購物與廣告情境常見，指「物超所值的東西」。當動詞時是「討價還價」，常搭配 bargain with。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: bargain with + 人 + over／for + 事物：和某人就某事討價還價；當名詞時 a bargain 是可數名詞。

example.en: The store has many bargains on winter coats this week.
example.zh: 這家店本週有許多冬季外套的特價品。

example.en: She bargained with the seller and saved twenty dollars.
example.zh: 她和賣家討價還價，省下了二十美元。

example.en: Bargaining over the price took almost an hour.
example.zh: 為價格討價還價花了將近一小時。

example.en: Our manager found a good bargain on office supplies.
example.zh: 我們的經理找到了一筆辦公用品的划算交易。

example.en: The hotel offers bargain prices during the winter season.
example.zh: 這間飯店在冬季提供特惠價格。

example.en: You can bargain with the owner about the monthly rent.
example.zh: 你可以和屋主討論每月租金。

example.en: The shop has a bargain sale at the end of every month.
example.zh: 這家店每個月底都有特賣會。

examples.en: At this price, the laptop is a real bargain.
examples.zh: 以這個價格來說，這台筆電真的很划算。

examples.en: Don't miss our bargain prices on office chairs this week.
examples.zh: 別錯過我們本週辦公椅的特惠價。

examples.en: We got a good bargain by ordering in large amounts.
examples.zh: 我們大量訂購，買到了很划算的價格。

examples.en: The buyer bargained with the supplier over the delivery fee.
examples.zh: 買方和供應商就運費討價還價。

confusable.diff: discount 是「折扣」（降價的金額或比例）；bargain 是「買到很划算的東西」。

example.en: The store gave us a ten percent discount on the order.
example.zh: 這家店給了我們這筆訂單九折優惠。

similar.diff: a good deal 和 a bargain 都是划算的交易；deal 較口語，也可指一般的交易或協議。

example.en: The travel agent offered us a great deal on flights.
example.zh: 旅行社為我們提供了很划算的機票方案。

example.en: The big sale at the mall ends on Sunday night.
example.zh: 購物中心的大特賣在週日晚上結束。

example.en: Show this coupon at the counter to save five dollars.
example.zh: 在櫃台出示這張優惠券可省五美元。

example.en: The store made us a special offer on bulk orders.
example.zh: 這家店對大量訂購提供了特別優惠。

example.en: The price of the tickets went up in March.
example.zh: 票價在三月調漲了。

example.en: These shoes were a bargain at half the usual price.
example.zh: 這雙鞋以半價購入，非常划算。

example.en: Customers often bargain with sellers at the open market.
example.zh: 顧客常在露天市場和賣家討價還價。

senses.en: something that costs less than it is worth
senses.distinguish: 和價格、購物、特價有關時，就是這個意思。

example.en: Buying the machine second-hand was a great bargain.
example.zh: 買二手機器是一筆很划算的交易。

senses.en: an agreement between two sides about what each will do
senses.distinguish: 和談判、合約、雙方承諾有關時，是這個意思，常見 keep one's side of the bargain。

example.en: Both companies kept their side of the bargain.
example.zh: 兩家公司都履行了自己在協議中的責任。

extra_vocab.en: the bags and suitcases that you take on a trip
extra_vocab.note: 機場、航空與飯店情境最常見，指旅客全部的行李，是總稱。航空公司的規定與公告多用 baggage。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: baggage 是不可數名詞，不加 s，也不能說 a baggage；要數時用 a piece of baggage 或 two bags。

example.en: Meet me at the baggage claim after you land.
example.zh: 你降落後在行李提領處和我碰面。

example.en: The baggage allowance for economy class is twenty kilograms.
example.zh: 經濟艙的行李限額是二十公斤。

example.en: Carry-on baggage must fit under the seat in front of you.
example.zh: 隨身行李必須能放進前方座位底下。

example.en: The airline charges a baggage fee for the second bag.
example.zh: 航空公司對第二件行李收取行李費。

examples.en: All passengers must put their baggage through the scanner.
examples.zh: 所有乘客都必須讓行李通過掃描機。

examples.en: The hotel staff will carry your baggage to your room.
examples.zh: 飯店人員會把您的行李送到房間。

examples.en: Each passenger may bring one piece of baggage on board.
examples.zh: 每位乘客可以帶一件行李登機。

examples.en: Her baggage was delayed, so she bought clothes for the meeting.
examples.zh: 她的行李延誤了，所以她買了衣服去開會。

confusable.diff: bag 是「一個袋子或包包」；baggage 是所有行李的總稱。
confusable.usage: bag 是可數名詞（one bag, two bags）；baggage 是不可數名詞，不加 s，也不加 a。

example.en: I packed two small bags for the three-day business trip.
example.zh: 我為三天的出差打包了兩個小包包。

similar.diff: luggage 意思幾乎相同，美式口語常用；baggage 在機場與航空公司用語中更常見，兩者都是不可數名詞。

example.en: Please keep your luggage with you at the station.
example.zh: 在車站請隨身看管您的行李。

example.en: He packed a small suitcase for the two-day trip.
example.zh: 他為兩天的行程打包了一個小行李箱。

example.en: Please show your passport at the check-in counter.
example.zh: 請在報到櫃台出示您的護照。

example.en: I left my plane ticket on the office desk.
example.zh: 我把機票忘在辦公桌上了。

extra_vocab.en: a car with a driver that you pay to take you somewhere
extra_vocab.note: 出差、機場接送與商務外出的情境常見，意思等同 taxi，美式口語更常說 cab。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「搭計程車」用 take a cab；表示交通方式時不加冠詞：go to the airport by cab。

example.en: Several cabs were waiting outside the conference hall.
example.zh: 好幾輛計程車在會議廳外等候。

example.en: It is faster to take a cab than a bus.
example.zh: 搭計程車比搭公車快。

example.en: Could you call a cab for me, please?
example.zh: 可以請你幫我叫輛計程車嗎？

example.en: The company will pay your cab fare to the airport.
example.zh: 公司會支付你到機場的計程車費。

example.en: The cab driver knew a shortcut to the convention center.
example.zh: 計程車司機知道一條到會展中心的捷徑。

examples.en: I took a cab from the hotel to the client's office.
examples.zh: 我從飯店搭計程車到客戶的辦公室。

examples.en: The cab will pick us up at the airport at six.
examples.zh: 計程車會在六點到機場接我們。

examples.en: We shared a cab to the conference center.
examples.zh: 我們合搭一輛計程車去會議中心。

examples.en: Please keep the cab receipt so we can pay you back.
examples.zh: 請保留計程車收據，我們才能把錢還給你。

confusable.diff: cap 是帽子，發音只差最後的 b／p，聽的時候要小心。

example.en: He wore a blue cap and waited for his cab.
example.zh: 他戴著藍色帽子，等著他的計程車。

similar.diff: taxi 英美都通用、較正式；cab 較口語，美式常用，兩者意思相同。

example.en: The hotel can call a taxi for you right now.
example.zh: 飯店現在就可以幫您叫計程車。

example.en: The cab fare to the airport is about thirty dollars.
example.zh: 到機場的計程車費大約三十美元。

example.en: The driver helped us put our bags in the trunk.
example.zh: 司機幫我們把行李放進後車廂。

example.en: The ride from the hotel to the office takes ten minutes.
example.zh: 從飯店到辦公室的車程要十分鐘。

example.en: The airport is thirty minutes from our office.
example.zh: 機場離我們的辦公室有三十分鐘的路程。

extra_vocab.en: a place in a school or company where people choose food and eat
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於公司、學校、醫院的內部餐廳，客人自己取餐再付錢，不是有服務生的餐廳。

example.en: Both cafeterias in the building close at two in the afternoon.
example.zh: 大樓裡的兩間餐廳都在下午兩點關門。

example.en: Most employees have lunch in the company cafeteria.
example.zh: 大部分員工在公司餐廳吃午餐。

example.en: Today's cafeteria menu includes soup, salad, and grilled fish.
example.zh: 今天的餐廳菜單有湯、沙拉和烤魚。

example.en: The cafeteria staff start work at seven every morning.
example.zh: 餐廳工作人員每天早上七點開始上班。

example.en: The school cafeteria offers healthy meals at low prices.
example.zh: 學校餐廳以低價提供健康餐點。

examples.en: Lunch is served in the main cafeteria from noon to one.
examples.zh: 午餐從中午到一點在主餐廳供應。

examples.en: The cafeteria will be closed for repairs next Monday.
examples.zh: 餐廳下週一將因維修而關閉。

examples.en: The staff party will be held in the cafeteria.
examples.zh: 員工派對將在餐廳舉行。

examples.en: Employees can get a ten percent discount at the cafeteria.
examples.zh: 員工在餐廳可享九折優惠。

confusable.diff: cafe 是咖啡館，客人坐下點飲料與輕食；cafeteria 是自己取餐的餐廳。

example.en: We met a client at a small cafe near the station.
example.zh: 我們在車站附近的一間小咖啡館和客戶碰面。

similar.diff: canteen 是英式說法，指公司、工廠或學校的餐廳，意思和 cafeteria 接近。

example.en: The factory canteen opens at eleven thirty for workers.
example.zh: 工廠的員工餐廳十一點半開放給員工。

example.en: We usually eat lunch together at noon.
example.zh: 我們通常中午一起吃午餐。

example.en: The restaurant changes its lunch menu every Monday morning.
example.zh: 這家餐廳每週一早上更換午餐菜單。

example.en: The meal comes with a drink and a small dessert.
example.zh: 這份餐點附有飲料和一份小甜點。

example.en: I bought a snack at the station before the meeting.
example.zh: 我在開會前於車站買了一份點心。

extra_vocab.en: a chart of days and months, or a tool for planning meetings and events
extra_vocab.note: 多益辦公室情境常用來指行事曆（排會議、約時間），也可指牆上或桌上的日曆。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 要把事情記進行事曆，用 add … to the calendar 或 put … on the calendar。

example.en: Please check your calendars and choose a date for the workshop.
example.zh: 請查看你們的行事曆，為工作坊選一個日期。

example.en: Let me check the calendar and call you back.
example.zh: 讓我看一下行事曆，再回電給你。

collocations.zh: 在行事曆上做記號提醒

example.en: Please mark your calendars for the annual meeting in May.
example.zh: 請在你們的行事曆上標記五月的年度會議。

example.en: Our sales grew by ten percent over the calendar year.
example.zh: 我們的銷售額在這個曆年成長了百分之十。

example.en: We have three client visits on the calendar this month.
example.zh: 這個月行事曆上排了三次客戶拜訪。

examples.en: I will add the meeting to everyone's calendar today.
examples.zh: 我今天會把這場會議加進大家的行事曆。

examples.en: I have sent a calendar invitation for Friday's workshop.
examples.zh: 我已經寄出週五工作坊的行事曆邀請。

examples.en: Mr. Lee's calendar is full until the end of next week.
examples.zh: 李先生的行程到下週末都排滿了。

examples.en: The sales event is already on the company calendar.
examples.zh: 這場銷售活動已經排進公司行事曆了。

confusable.diff: agenda 是會議的議程（要討論的項目）；calendar 是排日期與時間的行事曆。

example.en: The agenda for tomorrow's meeting has five main topics.
example.zh: 明天會議的議程有五個主要議題。

similar.diff: schedule 指時間安排表或行程；calendar 偏重日期與月曆的形式，兩者常一起使用。

example.en: The train schedule shows a departure at nine ten.
example.zh: 火車時刻表顯示九點十分發車。

example.en: I made an appointment with the manager for Monday.
example.zh: 我和經理約了週一見面。

example.en: The deadline for the report is next Wednesday.
example.zh: 報告的截止日期是下週三。

example.en: The meeting starts at ten in the main room.
example.zh: 會議十點在大會議室開始。

example.en: Please confirm the date of the training session.
example.zh: 請確認這場培訓課程的日期。

senses.en: a tool for planning meetings and things to do
senses.distinguish: 和排會議、約時間、邀請有關時，是這個意思。

example.en: Please check my calendar before you set up the meeting.
example.zh: 安排會議前，請先查看我的行事曆。

senses.en: a chart that shows the days and months of a year
senses.distinguish: 提到牆上、桌上或紙本時，是這個意思。

example.en: There is a calendar on the wall above my desk.
example.zh: 我的辦公桌上方牆上掛著一份日曆。

senses.en: a list of important dates and events in a year
senses.distinguish: 前面常有 school、company 等字，表示一整年的重要日期。

example.en: The school calendar shows all holidays for this year.
example.zh: 學校的行事曆列出了今年所有的假日。

extra_vocab.en: a room on a plane or ship, or a small house made of wood
extra_vocab.note: 多益機場與航空情境常指飛機的客艙（cabin crew 是空服員）；度假情境也可指山中或湖邊的小木屋。

example.en: The resort has ten wooden cabins near the lake.
example.zh: 這處度假村在湖邊有十間木屋。

example.en: The cabin crew served drinks soon after takeoff.
example.zh: 空服人員在起飛後不久就送上飲料。

example.en: Cabin baggage must be small enough to fit above the seat.
example.zh: 客艙行李必須小到能放進座位上方。

example.en: The first-class cabin has wider seats and more space.
example.zh: 頭等艙的座位比較寬，空間也比較大。

examples.en: The cabin was quiet during the long flight to Tokyo.
examples.zh: 飛往東京的長途航程中，客艙很安靜。

examples.en: A flight attendant walked through the cabin to check seat belts.
examples.zh: 空服員走過客艙檢查安全帶。

examples.en: We rented a cabin by the lake for our team trip.
examples.zh: 我們為團隊旅遊在湖邊租了一間小木屋。

examples.en: Each passenger on the cruise has a private cabin.
examples.zh: 這趟郵輪的每位乘客都有自己的艙房。

confusable.diff: cabinet 是櫃子（如檔案櫃）或內閣，比 cabin 多了 -et。
confusable.usage: cabin 指客艙或小木屋；cabinet 是放東西的櫃子，兩個字拼法與發音都很像。

example.en: Please put the files in the cabinet behind my desk.
example.zh: 請把檔案放進我桌子後面的櫃子裡。

confusable.diff: cab 是計程車；cabin 是客艙或小木屋。

example.en: We took a cab from the airport to the hotel.
example.zh: 我們從機場搭計程車到飯店。

example.en: The flight crew greeted every passenger at the door.
example.zh: 機組人員在門口迎接每一位乘客。

example.en: Please do not leave your bags in the aisle.
example.zh: 請不要把行李放在走道上。

example.en: I booked a window seat for the morning flight.
example.zh: 我為早班飛機訂了靠窗的座位。

example.en: The pilot told us the flight would be short.
example.zh: 機長告訴我們這趟飛行會很短。

senses.en: the part of a plane where passengers sit
senses.distinguish: 和飛機、空服員、座位有關時，是這個意思。

example.en: The flight crew checked the cabin before the plane landed.
example.zh: 飛機降落前，機組人員檢查了客艙。

senses.en: a small house made of wood, often in the mountains or by a lake
senses.distinguish: 和度假、租房、湖邊或山上有關時，是這個意思。

example.en: They spent the holiday in a cabin in the mountains.
example.zh: 他們在山上的一間小木屋度過假期。

senses.en: a room for passengers on a ship
senses.distinguish: 和郵輪、渡輪、船票有關時，是這個意思。

example.en: Our cabin on the ferry has two beds and a window.
example.zh: 我們渡輪上的艙房有兩張床和一扇窗。

extra_vocab.en: a box made of wire or bars for keeping birds or animals
extra_vocab.note: 多益中較少見，出現在寵物、動物園、倉庫與運輸情境，指關動物的籠子，也可指倉庫裡上鎖的鐵網儲藏區。

example.en: The zoo has ten cages for small animals and birds.
example.zh: 動物園有十個籠子養小動物和鳥類。

example.en: The staff caged the parrots before the truck arrived.
example.zh: 卡車抵達前，工作人員把鸚鵡關進了籠子。

example.en: The team is caging the animals before the move.
example.zh: 團隊正在搬遷前把動物關進籠子裡。

example.en: He cleaned the bird cage before the pet show.
example.zh: 他在寵物展前把鳥籠清理乾淨。

example.en: The rabbits are kept in a cage at night.
example.zh: 兔子晚上被關在籠子裡。

collocations.zh: 上鎖的籠子（鐵網儲藏區）

example.en: Keep the samples in a locked cage after work.
example.zh: 下班後請把樣品存放在上鎖的鐵籠裡。

example.en: Make sure the cage door is closed before you leave.
example.zh: 離開前請確認籠門已關好。

examples.en: Please keep your dog in a cage during the flight.
examples.zh: 飛行期間，請把您的狗放在籠子裡。

examples.en: The zoo built a larger cage for the new tiger.
examples.zh: 動物園為新來的老虎蓋了一個更大的籠子。

examples.en: Expensive tools are kept in a locked cage in the warehouse.
examples.zh: 貴重的工具放在倉庫裡一個上鎖的鐵籠中。

examples.en: The airline checks the size of each pet cage at the gate.
examples.zh: 航空公司在登機門檢查每個寵物籠的大小。

confusable.diff: case 是箱子、盒子或案件，發音很像 cage，但最後沒有 /dʒ/ 的音。

example.en: Put the camera in its case before the trip.
example.zh: 出發旅行前，請把相機放進它的盒子裡。

similar.diff: crate 是裝貨物的大木箱或板條箱，也可裝寵物；cage 是用鐵絲或欄杆做的籠子。

example.en: The vases were packed in a wooden crate for shipping.
example.zh: 花瓶被裝進木箱準備運送。

example.en: You may bring a small pet on this train.
example.zh: 您可以帶小型寵物搭乘這班火車。

example.en: Our team visited the zoo on the company trip.
example.zh: 我們的團隊在公司旅遊時參觀了動物園。

example.en: A bird flew into the lobby this morning.
example.zh: 今天早上有一隻鳥飛進了大廳。

example.en: The bird cage is too small for two birds.
example.zh: 這個鳥籠對兩隻鳥來說太小了。

example.en: Workers cage the animals before moving them to a new place.
example.zh: 工作人員在把動物搬到新地方前，會先把牠們關進籠子。
